viewer: Hindi-speaking viewers who watched ep1 or land cold, scrolling alone at night
hook: मैं पानी में उतरा, तो लगा किसी ने मेरी छाती पर हाथ रख दिया।
payoff: The hand on his chest becomes literal: after he answers the kind voice, the lake grips his chest; a small hand shoves him out.
belief_label: invented village saying inside a fiction; not a real belief or safety advice
sources: Original story (Doomsday Horror). Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS, sound synthesized in code.

series.next_hook: तभी पीछे से एक छोटे हाथ ने मुझे किनारे की तरफ़ धकेल दिया।

story.setup: He wades into the lake toward the lit, dry boat that brought his missing brother's jacket.

rule_or_clue.text: नाव की आवाज़ का जवाब मत दो
rule_or_clue.line: गाँव वाले कहते हैं, जवाब मत दो

rule_or_clue.text: he has called his brother for three nights
rule_or_clue.line: तीन रात से मैं किनारे से पुकार रहा था

rule_or_clue.text: warm water in a December lake
rule_or_clue.line: जो दिसंबर की झील में हो ही नहीं सकता

rule_or_clue.text: the cabin murmurs haan in many voices
rule_or_clue.line: बहुत सारे लोगों का एक ही शब्द है

escalation.text: the water turns warm and his shivering stops
the cabin murmurs yes in many voices
the jacket is body-warm and smells of his brother
escalation.line: सीट की लाल जैकेट गर्म थी

false_relief.text: he believes his brother is alive
false_relief.line: मुझे लगा कि वह ज़िंदा है

twist.text: the hook's hand on his chest is literal: the lake grips him
twist.line: पानी ने मेरी छाती को उसी हाथ की तरह जकड़ लिया
twist.how: The cold at the first step was not weather: the lake was already reaching for his chest, and the grip arrives once he answers.

story.part_question: Who is calling from the boat and what does it want?

part_payoff.text: it wants one answer; he gives it

ending_image.text: a small wet hand slaps his back and shoves him toward the bank as the frame cuts to black

callback.text: the small hand that shoves him ashore answers the hand that gripped him
callback.line: एक छोटे हाथ ने मुझे किनारे की तरफ़ धकेल दिया

first_seen.line: नाव ने मेरा पूरा नाम लिया

new_facts: The narrator has called for his brother on the shore for three nights
The water is warm near the boat; the cabin murmurs "हाँ" in many voices
The voice that calls the narrator is his own voice, raised and softened
A small wet hand pushes him out of the water
